topic: Campaign report chart period logic update
summary_markdown: A developer ([p1]) updated the controller for campaign reports (`/api/campaigns/report/charts`) due to changing requirements. Previously, two separate endpoint calls were used with different data ranges. The update modifies the first chart's period calculation: it will now always use the full previous month's dates, while the second report remains configurable by a selected period (database or airing).
decisions: The first chart in the campaign report must always display data for the full previous calendar month.
action_items: [me] to review the updated controller logic.
